outcome: Time to reach specific urine output thresholds (500 mL, 1,000 mL, 1,500 mL)
cohort: Participants were 276 women undergoing elective singleton caesarean sections, excluding those with medical conditions affecting urine output, postpartum hemorrhage, or non-standard fluid/uterotonic use.
finding: Carbetocin resulted in significantly higher total urine output in the first 6 hours compared to oxytocin.
